source.localOverrides: Display vocabulary and version-8 POL/POI placement refinements; original Sheet attribution retained.

pointsOfInterest.name: Bridge
pointsOfInterest.placement: On river only. If there's a PL in 3-hex proximity of river, there's 80% chance to spawn bridge OR ferry. Bridge is preferred. Wooden near towns and villages, stone near towns and cities. One crossing in reasonable radius on the same river.

pointsOfInterest.name: Ruins
pointsOfInterest.placement: Prefers mountains, dense forests, islands, wetlands. Dislikes PL and farmlands. Version 8 also favours deep dense forest with an additional multiplier capped at 2.

pointsOfInterest.name: Encampment
pointsOfInterest.placement: Prefers meadows, light forests. Version 8 adds a modest river/lake proximity preference.

pointsOfInterest.name: Watchtower
pointsOfInterest.placement: Prefers meadows, elevation and PL proximity. Greatly prefers cliffs (elevation shift 2 levels or more). When on the coast, it's a watchtower 50% in version 8 (75% in versions 6/7). Can spawn on islands. Dislikes dense forests. Can spawn in PL.

pointsOfInterest.name: Stronghold
pointsOfInterest.props: building with gate and towers (1-3), different shape of building and height of towers
pointsOfInterest.placement: No more than one per region. Prefers 2-3 elevation and mountains proximity. Prefers farmlands. Dislikes wetlands. Can spawn adjacent to PL. Cannot spawn in PL.

pointsOfInterest.name: Lair
pointsOfInterest.placement: Prefers wetlands, mountains, canyons, penisulas, islands. Greatly dislikes PL proximity.

pointsOfInterest.name: Mystic
pointsOfInterest.placement: Rare. Prefers penisulas, islands, lakes proximity. Can spawn adjacent to or in PL. Version 8 also favours deep dense forest with an additional multiplier capped at 2.

pointsOfInterest.name: Abbey
pointsOfInterest.props: chapel style building, no religious marks
pointsOfInterest.placement: Prefers farmlands and villages proximity. Can spawn adjacent to village or town. Cannot spawn in PL. Version 8 also favours whole islands of one to three hexes.

pointsOfInterest.name: Battlefield
pointsOfInterest.placement: Rare. Prefers meadows. Cannot spawn in PL. Can spawn adjacent to watchtower and stronghold and doesn't count to the limit then.

pointsOfInterest.name: Dungeon
pointsOfInterest.placement: Prefers mountains strongly. Mine when near settlements, dungeon when not. Version 8 permits the mine subtype in settlement hexes.

terrain.name: Meadow
terrain.placement: Default terrain type. There should be some kind of minimal percentage of meadow/farmlands hexes to the overall land hexes ratio.

terrain.name: Light woodland
terrain.hue: W for deciduous, C for evergreen
terrain.placement: Instead of meadows, generally more towards land centre, but more common near river banks and lakes. Can form larger clusters.

terrain.name: Dense woodland
terrain.hue: W for deciduous, C for evergreen
terrain.placement: Instead of light woodland, generally with increasing probability closer to mountains and 3-elevation. Light woodland clusters tends to change most of their tiles into dense woodlands. Tends to form clusters themselves.

terrain.name: Wetlands
terrain.props: puddles, swamp grass, occasionally single deciduous tree
terrain.placement: Much more uncommon than woodland. Spawn instead of meadows after woodlands generation. More common near lakes and in canyons.

terrain.name: Point of light
terrain.props: buildings (numbers and density increasing with PL type — village, town, city)
terrain.placement: Start with cities (0-1 per region), then towns (0-2 per region), then villages (0-5 per region). General rules: settlements prefer open water and rivers proximity, meadows or light woodland around, and elevation. Dislikes wetlands and high elevation changes around. Version 8 plans at most two cities/towns combined and four villages per region, reduces settlement rolls and footprint budgets on water-heavy regions, and allows rare elevation-3/steep sites plus village-only mountain slopes.

terrain.name: Farmlands
terrain.placement: Changed from meadows only after points of light placement. At most 2 tiles from PL. Prefers water proximity.
